reviewer: independent second-pass visual review agent (Claude, subagent; did not author r1)

supported_strengths: Drum: 24 pilaster bays with slot groups in a 2-slotted:1-plain rhythm on S/SW matches Mackey_Arena_Purdue_University_2016_02.jpg and exponent_drone_2025_04.jpg (renders/rv_match_2016_02_SW_ground.png, renders/rv_match_drone04_SW.png).
SW entrance: recessed glazed door banks between brick piers under soffit, consistent with 2016_02 (r1/r1_close_SW_entrance.png).
Wing: punched windows between limestone bands, storefront at ground on the plaza side, four glazed tower/penthouse volumes (r1/r1_elev_E.png).

deductions.issue: Modelled as dark glazed slits with aluminium frames spanning z 7.2-16.3 m (~80% of drum height). Photos show light grey louvre panels occupying only the lower ~55-65% of each slotted bay, under full-height recessed vertical brick channels.

deductions.feature: SE wing east face (Northwestern Ave, south of east entrance)
deductions.issue: Model: evenly spaced wide 2-light ground windows and single/pair upper windows, no corner bay. Source: glazed 3-light corner bay with grey metal surround on both floors at the SE tip, then a group of 4 narrow slit windows on each floor aligned vertically, then a recessed ground-floor arcade under a projecting second-floor canopy with storefront behind piers.

deductions.feature: East wing between 2nd and 3rd P towers and north of 3rd P tower
deductions.issue: Model shows three window tiers over much of this length; drone photo shows two tiers: recessed storefront arcade between brick piers with limestone bases at ground, one row of paired/single upper windows with limestone heads/sills, then a blank banded parapet zone.

Model has storefront plus TWO separate rows of punched upper windows; HNTB photo shows storefront plus ONE tier of tall upper windows (single wide gridded units and narrow pairs) under a banded parapet.
Modelled as a 2-row grid of small dark panes; source shows full-height storefront entrance with MACKEY ARENA letters above. Evidence is distant/dusk.
Uniform full-height glass with P; source towers have the P on a grey horizontal-louvre metal band with glazing above/below and storefront at the base.
No daylight source for the north elevation/rounded north end, north half of the east facade, west annex facades, or drum north/east bays; their openings are rhythm-assumed and cannot be verified.

supported_strengths: Ribbed copper-tan dome with concentric seam rings and small central cap (sources/mackey_ortho_2023_hr.jpg vs renders/rv_top_overlay_blend.png).
Flared bronze fascia band, 24 limestone pilasters, drum base course (2016_02 vs rv_match_2016_02_SW_ground.png).
SW (Morgan & Kate Burke) entrance with soffit, piers and two-line lettering (2016_02, drone_04 vs r1_close_SW_entrance.png).
East entrance recess with MACKEY ARENA / HOME OF PURDUE BASKETBALL banner, 44 and 59 banners, flanking glass P towers (drone_05 vs rv_match_drone05_E.png).
Concourse ring with water table, two limestone stripes and coping; south block; west annex; four penthouses (ortho, 2016_02).

deductions.issue: Source entrance front above the 3-bay portal is CURVED (banner wall in 2025; curved two-storey glass bay in 2016) with large separate 44 and 59 banners on projecting piers and vertical blade banners (MACKEY ARENA / KEADY COURT); model is a flat wall with small side panels and no blade banners.

deductions.feature: SDAC curved glass lobby (SW corner of SDAC, facing Weist Plaza)
deductions.issue: Source: prominent convex two-storey curtain-wall lobby with metal fascia. Model: flat dark two-level glazing band set in the brick wall; no curvature.
Source fascia is a vertically corrugated/ribbed metal band; model is smooth with two reveal lines.
Full-height recessed vertical brick channels in slotted bays (visible above the louvres) are missing.
Composition simplified (no louvre band behind P, no metal-panel penthouse cladding pattern).
Missing glazed corner bay with metal surround, projecting second-floor canopy over recessed ground-floor arcade, and limestone accent inlays in the attic band.
No MACKEY ARENA lettering on north entrance; Pyramid of Success and Wooden statue are crude blocks at estimated positions.
North rounded end, north half of east facade and west annex details unseen in daylight sources; cannot be credited as verified.

supported_strengths: Footprint/plan: reviewer top render registered to the 2023 orthophoto local box aligns closely for drum, wing outline (incl. rounded north end and west concave curve), penthouses, west annex and south block (renders/rv_top_overlay_blend.png).
Shallow ribbed dome form and continuous east/north wing massing (ortho, drone_01/05).

deductions.feature: Drum height vs concourse ring / dome crown
deductions.issue: Visible drum (concourse roof to fascia underside) : concourse wall height is ~1.2 in drone_04 and ~0.8 from the ground in 2016_02, versus ~2.1 and ~1.6 in matched model renders. Drum height : 15-degree bay chord is ~0.79 in 2016_02 / ~0.80 in drone_04 vs ~0.96 in the model. From the 2016_02 ground position the dome crown shows clearly above the fascia; in the matched model view it is hidden. Drum is too tall and/or the concourse ring too low; re-derive drum/concourse/fascia/dome heights.
All heights (ring 5.8, drum top 17.4, apex 27.9, wing 14.0 m) are photo estimates with no measured datum.
North lobby/concourse between drum and Brees Center and the rounded north end are seen only in plan (ortho) or distant dusk photo; elevation massing unverified.
Curved east-entrance front and curved SDAC lobby are flat/faceted in silhouette.

evidence.prior_findings_context: audit/mackey_arena/INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_round3.md (first-pass rubric, 8.0/10; not used for this grade)

findings.correction: Re-derive heights from matched views: visible drum ~1.2x concourse wall height (drone_04), dome crown visible above fascia from SW ground (2016_02). Lower drum top and/or raise concourse ring so drum height ≈ 0.8 of a 15° bay chord; re-check fascia depth and dome rise.
Replace dark glazed slits with light warm-grey louvre panels (sRGB ≈150,146,132) confined to the lower ~55-65% of the bay, set inside full-height recessed vertical brick channels.

Make the facade above the 3-bay portal follow a curve (convex arc) as in drone_05/2016_01; enlarge 44 and 59 banners as separate tall panels on projecting piers with sub-captions; add vertical MACKEY ARENA / KEADY COURT blade banners.

findings.facade: East wing between P towers and north of 3rd P
findings.correction: Use two tiers (recessed ground storefront arcade between brick piers with limestone bases + one row of paired/single upper windows with limestone heads/sills) and a blank banded parapet, per drone_05.
Storefront + one tier of tall upper windows (wide gridded units alternating with narrow pairs) per hntb_Purdue-2; remove the extra upper row.
Model the convex two-storey curtain-wall lobby with mullion grid and metal fascia band facing Weist Plaza.

findings.facade: SE wing (south tip and east face)
findings.correction: Add glazed corner bay with grey metal surround on both floors; 4 aligned narrow slits per floor; projecting second-floor canopy over recessed ground-floor arcade with storefront; limestone accent inlays in attic band.
Vertically corrugated fascia; shift colour toward sampled (188,158,112) (more saturated golden bronze).
P mounted on a grey horizontal-louvre metal band with glazing above/below and storefront base; penthouse metal-panel cladding.

findings.facade: North (Weist Plaza) / north end / west annex
findings.correction: Obtain current daylight photos of the north elevation, rounded north end, east facade north half and west annex; add MACKEY ARENA lettering and full-height storefront at the north entrance; refine plaza monuments.
Lighten concourse ring roof toward ortho (167,162,154); slightly raise dome and concourse/wing brick value toward sunlit samples while keeping hue.
After acceptance, update modular/manifest.json object list/count/bounds for the r1+ asset (coordinator-owned).

uncertainties: Source camera positions (Commons GPS) and panorama projection of 2016_01/02 are approximate; proportion finding relies on ratios measured in several sources, not absolute heights.
Colour comparisons mix sunlit 2016 photos, overcast/dusk 2025 drone shots and a 2023 orthophoto; brick/dome value differences of ~0.1 V are within lighting uncertainty and were deducted lightly.
2016 vs 2025 east-entrance state: curved glass bay (2016) appears covered by curved banner wall (2025); curvature is supported by both.
Whether the SDAC tall upper windows span two floors internally is unknown; the exterior shows one tier.
North elevation, rounded north end, east facade north half, west annex facades and drum N/E bays remain unverified.
